facts.text: I swore off rescues. Coffee's on, so grab a mug before the radio goes.
facts.why: Not a Gabe line. The quote page lists lines like 'You're not gonna die.' and 'Don't think so.' with nothing about coffee or rescues. Gabe does quit the rangers after Sarah falls, but these words are not his. Printed in quote marks and signed Gabe Walker.
facts.fix: Coffee's on. Radio's quiet. Keep it that way. (set as a written note, no quote marks)
